content.title: Experimental forecast calls for ‘super’ El Niño by winter - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Scott DanceA fast-forming and strengthening El Niño climate pattern could peak this winter as one of the most intense ever observed, according to an experimental forecast released Tuesday. The new prediction system suggested it could reach top-tier “super” El Niño strength, a level that in the past has unleashed deadly fires, drought, heat waves, floods and mudslides around the world.450 CommentsMost ReadLiz GoodwinHow Eric Swalwell rose to the top of Democratic politics as rumors followed himEarlier todayDan LamotheU.S. sends thousands more troops to Mideast as Trump seeks to squeeze Iran2 hours agoGretchen ReynoldsWant to control your blood sugar?
